name: Clothes
overview: Scripture reveals that clothing serves both practical and symbolic purposes, as God clothed Adam and Eve with coats of skins after the fall, signifying His provision and care (Genesis 3:21). The detailed instructions for priestly garments emphasize clothing's role in representing glory and beauty before the Lord (Exodus 28:40, 42). Additionally, God's design includes clear distinctions in attire between men and women, with deviation described as an abomination (Deuteronomy 22:5). Jesus teaches believers not to be anxious about clothing, reminding them that life and the body are of greater value than outward apparel (Matthew 6:25; Luke 12:22).
